no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Decoy Therapeutics (post-merger with Salarius, Jan 2026) is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company. Lead program DCOY101 (pan-Coronavirus prophylactic) is in late lead optimization with planned IND filing in H1 2027. TRI program (Flu/COVID/RSV) and P-PROTAC program are exploratory/discovery stage. Legacy Salarius asset SP-2577 (LSD-1 inhibitor) MD Anderson investigator-initiated trial enrollment ended Jan 2026; company seeking out-licensing. SP-3164 protein degrader is integrated into platform but not in active trials.
